title: The Palmetto Blue
meta_description: Sweeping ocean views, a sparkling community pool, and beach access just steps away -- experience it all at The Palmetto Blue!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Escape to The Palmetto Blue! This beautiful 3-story beach getaway greets you with bright interiors, chic decor, and modern finishes. Head up to the second floor where you'll find a sleek, fully equipped kitchen and dining area with seating for 8. The comfortable living area is located on the 3rd floor, boasting a backdrop of ocean views. Fire up the grill and dine alfresco on the covered spacious balcony accompanied by the sea breeze. Each of the four bedrooms features a king bed and TV. Two of the bedrooms offer a private ensuite bathroom, while two additional full bathrooms ensure convenience and privacy for everyone.

ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is conveniently located between Panama City Beach and Santa Rosa Beach which gives you many options for outdoor activities, dining, and entertainment. For a day of adventure, spend the day at Camp Helen State Park (next to Inlet Beach), where you have pristine beaches, a coastal dune lake where you can rent kayaks and new YOLO paddle boards or bring your own! There's plenty of parking, restrooms, picnic tables and much more. There is an entry fee of $4 per vehicle. After all the fun in the sun, there are endless dining options at 30Avenue Shops, Barrett's Square in Rosemary, and Pier Park in Panama City Beach.

BEACH ACCESS: This home is just steps away from Inlet Beach Public Beach Access, which has bathrooms, showers, and plenty of parking.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 / King bed, Ensuite (1st floor)
• Bedroom 2 / King bed, Ensuite (1st floor)
• Bedroom 3 / King bed (2nd floor)
• Bedroom 4 / King bed (3rd floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Bikes, 2 beach chairs, 1 beach umbrella
• Steps to Inlet Beach Regional Access
• 4 king bedrooms, 2 with private ensuite bathrooms
• Multiple balconies with seating
• Back balcony with outdoor dining table and ocean views
• Outdoor shower and grill
• Full size laundry room
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash cloths, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note the fireplace in the living room is not for guest use.

Parking Details:
- 3 parking spaces available in the driveway.
- Additional cars will be towed.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
